name: io.github.capazme/mcp-legal-it
description: Model Context Protocol server with 228 tools for Italian law: calculations (damages, interests, deadlines, parcels, taxes), legislation (Normattiva, EUR-Lex), case law (Cassazione, Corte Costituzionale, CGUE, TAR/CdS), Gazzetta Ufficiale, parliamentary bills, GDPR compliance and document generation. Every local calculation is audited, every online consult is declared in the answer's _meta.

environmentVariables.name: LEGAL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Restrict the exposed surface to a practice area (sinistro, credito, penale, fiscale, normativa, privacy, studio, redattore, cowork). Unset or 'full' exposes all 228 tools.

environmentVariables.name: LEGAL_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'off' to keep the server entirely off disk: the cache directory is then never read nor created.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Relocates the cache directory (default ~/.cache/mcp-legal-it). It only relocates the files; LEGAL_CACHE=off is the switch that stops them.

environmentVariables.name: LEGAL_TODAY
environmentVariables.description: Pins today's date (ISO) so every 'as of today' answer is reproducible.

environmentVariables.name: LEGAL_NOW
environmentVariables.description: Pins the current datetime (ISO); when both are set, LEGAL_TODAY derives from it.
